cards.name: Smart
cards.welcome_benefit: First-year fee of Rs 499 waived as a limited-period offer (verify at application)
cards.eligibility: Age 18-65, stable monthly income, resident of bank's sourcing cities
cards.notes: Flat 2% cashback on online spends (cap Rs 1,000/month) and 1% on other spends (cap Rs 500/month); total cashback up to Rs 18,000/year. base_monthly_cap models the offline 1% cap, bonus_monthly_cap the online 2% cap. Also pitches 0.99% p.m. EMI conversion with nil processing fee and 90-day extended interest-free period at issuance. Forex markup assumed at SC standard 3.5% (not stated on product page).

cards.name: Rewards

merchant_bonuses.merchant: All retail spends above Rs 20,000 in a month (total 8 RP/Rs 150)

cards.welcome_benefit: No joining fee; 4,000 bonus reward points credited if annual fee is levied (i.e. when waiver spend not met)
cards.lounge_access: 1 complimentary domestic lounge visit per calendar quarter (4/year)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver (txn Rs 400-2,000), waiver capped ~Rs 400/month
cards.reward_exclusions: Government, insurance and fuel earn only 1 RP/Rs 150 (govt/insurance) or surcharge waiver only (fuel); rent (MCC 6513) attracts 1% fee
cards.eligibility: Age 18-65, stable monthly income, resident of bank's sourcing cities
cards.notes: 4 RP/Rs 150 base on retail; additional 4 RP/Rs 150 on monthly retail spends above Rs 20,000, bonus capped at 2,000 RP per statement cycle. Point value: Rs 0.25 via rewards catalogue, Rs 0.20 as statement credit; Rs 99 redemption fee, 1,000-point minimum. rupee_per_point uses catalogue value.

cards.name: Ultimate
cards.welcome_benefit: 6,000 reward points (worth Rs 6,000) on payment of joining fee
cards.lounge_access: Domestic: 4 complimentary visits per calendar quarter. International: 1 complimentary Priority Pass visit per month, conditional on Rs 20,000 spend in previous month
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver, capped Rs 1,000/month (per product page); fuel earns no reward points
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns no points; utilities, supermarkets, insurance, property management, schools and government payments earn reduced 3 RP/Rs 150 (2 per Rs 100); rent (MCC 6513) attracts 1% fee
cards.eligibility: Age 21-65, stable monthly income, resident of bank's sourcing cities
cards.notes: Flagship card: 5 RP/Rs 150 (3.33%), 1 RP = Re 1 -- best point value in SC lineup, but redemption catalogue was pruned in the Apr 2023 devaluation (no Amazon Pay/gold vouchers). Reduced 3 RP/Rs 150 rate on utilities/supermarket/insurance/govt categories. 5% cashback on overseas duty-free spends. Complimentary golf access at premier Indian courses. Insurance: Rs 1 cr air accident, USD 25,000 overseas medical. No renewal-fee waiver published.

cards.name: EaseMyTrip
cards.milestone_benefits: On EaseMyTrip: flat 20% off hotels (cap Rs 5,000 domestic / Rs 10,000 international per booking) and 10% off flights (cap Rs 1,000 domestic / Rs 5,000 international); Rs 125 off bus tickets (min Rs 500). Each discount usable once per month
cards.lounge_access: 2 complimentary domestic lounge visits per calendar year (international lounge benefit withdrawn 15 Oct 2024)
cards.reward_exclusions: Aggregator (OTA) travel bookings earn base rate only, not 10x; rent (MCC 6513) attracts 1% fee
cards.eligibility: Age 18-65, stable monthly income, resident of bank's sourcing cities
cards.notes: 10 RP/Rs 100 on standalone airline/hotel spends and 2 RP/Rs 100 elsewhere; 1 RP = Rs 0.25, so effective 2.5% / 0.5%. Third-party sources report no monthly cap on 10x earning. Welcome benefit not published on current product page. Forex markup assumed at SC standard 3.5%.

cards.name: Platinum Rewards
cards.welcome_benefit: None (zero joining fee if Rs 500 spent within 30 days of issuance, else one-time Rs 250 fee)
cards.eligibility: Age 21-65 (add-on 18+), stable monthly income, resident of bank's sourcing cities
cards.notes: 5 RP/Rs 150 on dining and fuel with no monthly cap; 1 RP/Rs 150 elsewhere. Point value assumed Rs 0.25 (SC 360 rewards standard; not stated on product page). Annual fee Rs 250 from year 2; fee-waiver spend threshold not published. Forex markup assumed at SC standard 3.5%.

cards.name: Priority Visa Infinite
cards.lounge_access: Domestic: 4 complimentary visits per calendar quarter. International: complimentary Priority Pass; 2 visits/month for clients with Rs 30 lakh+ funds under management
cards.eligibility: Invitation card for Standard Chartered Priority Banking clients (relationship-based); age 21-65
cards.notes: Lifetime free for Priority relationship holders (third-party sources cite Rs 3,000 annual fee for non-Priority issuance). 5 RP/Rs 100 on international and retail-fashion spends, 2 RP/Rs 100 otherwise. Point value taken as Rs 0.25 (360 rewards standard; official page loosely says 1 RP = Re 1 -- redemption-dependent, so treated cautiously). Insurance: Rs 1 cr air accident, USD 25,000 medical. Points valid 3 years.

cards.name: Manhattan
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns nothing; rent (MCC 6513) attracts 1% fee
cards.notes: DISCONTINUED for new applications (SC pruned its lineup; legacy product page still resolves but the card is not actively issued -- confirmed by community reports). Mixed earner: 5% supermarket cashback (historically capped ~Rs 500/month, ~Rs 150/transaction; modelled via bonus_monthly_cap in cashback rupees) plus 3 RP/Rs 150 on other spends. base_points_per_100 0.5 is the rupee-equivalent of 3 RP/Rs 150 at Rs 0.25/RP so a single rupee_per_point of 1 works; actual points value Rs 0.25. Cashback redemption threshold revised per bank FAQ.

cards.name: Super Value Titanium

merchant_bonuses.merchant: Telephone bills (5% cashback, min txn Rs 750, Rs 200/month)
Utility bills (5% cashback, min txn Rs 750, Rs 100/month)

cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver withdrawn 25 Aug 2024; replaced by 5% fuel cashback (was 4%)
cards.reward_exclusions: Cashback categories subject to per-category monthly caps; rent (MCC 6513) attracts 1% fee
cards.notes: DISCONTINUED for new applications (SC pruned its lineup; legacy page still resolves). Was SC's fuel/utility card: 5% cashback on fuel (Rs 200/mo cap), phone (Rs 200/mo) and utilities (Rs 100/mo) -- combined bonus cap modelled as Rs 500/month -- plus 1 RP/Rs 150 elsewhere. base_points_per_100 0.17 is the rupee-equivalent of 1 RP/Rs 150 at Rs 0.25/RP so rupee_per_point 1 applies uniformly.

cards.name: DigiSmart
cards.reward_exclusions: No reward points on any spend; value came only from partner instant discounts
cards.notes: DISCONTINUED: new applications stopped 15 Dec 2022; existing holders retained benefits. Fee was Rs 49 + GST per month (~Rs 588/yr, modelled as annual_fee), waived on Rs 5,000 monthly spend (historical). Discount partners (Myntra 20%, Zomato 10%, Ola, EazyDiner, etc.) have been progressively withdrawn -- Myntra offer ended 1 Mar 2025 -- leaving the card with little ongoing value.
